name: platform-stack
description: Capability cards with a sticky, numbered side index whose active dot takes each card's accent. Each card: accent-tinted wash, title, copy, link and a product screenshot running off the bottom edge. Figma: Home Page > Platform (4331:24729).

kicker.description: Optional emphatic line under the intro (hidden in the current design).

items.description: Cards. Each: title and body (required); optional nav_label (defaults to title), link_label, link_url, image, image_alt, accent (indigo, yellow, red, green, ursa). The word UrsaAI is styled as the brand mark.

nav_title.description: Accessible name for the side index.
